message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: Defendant Wei (卫某某) bought prohibited cultural relics (copper artifacts) from Li, intending to resell for profit. He also defrauded victim Yu (俞某某) by promising to purchase and sell artifacts for profit, got 5 million RMB, used it for personal purposes, later gave back 1 million and some low-value artifacts. The artifacts are classified as level 3 cultural relics (i.e., protected). So crimes: illegal dealing in cultural relics (illegal possession, sale, trafficking) and fraud (诈骗). Possibly also illegal acquisition of cultural relics (非法买卖文物). The prosecution says "构成××和诈骗罪". So answer should include "非法买卖文物" (illegal trade of cultural relics) and "诈骗". In examples they used terms like "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" etc. For cultural relics, typical Chinese criminal law: "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal buying and selling of cultural relics). Also "诈骗罪". So output: [罪名]非法买卖文物;诈骗<eoa>.
